Package com.egradx.auth.support

Class EgradxAuthAudit

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.support.EgradxAuthAudit
public final class EgradxAuthAudit extends Object
How egradx-auth records what happens: it publishes EgradxAuditEvents as Spring application events. egradx-audit, when the application has it, stores them; without it they go nowhere — this library does not depend on it.

What is recorded, by rule: sign-in, credential and token flows, successes and failures alike; administrative changes, only when they succeed and only when something actually changed. See EgradxAuthAuditActions for the list.
